notes: Base catalogue: en-gb locale (same clean single-brand base used by the prior Home-Decor pass for this company, per notes/150.md). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Checked main hamburger nav (GIFTS > Bestsellers is a real top-level nav entry, data-cy=hamburgerMenuMobile-Bestsellers), sitemap.xml (only one bestsellers URL: /en-gb/gifts/bestsellers; no per-category Bestsellers sub-splits exist, unlike the Sale section), and the rendered page itself. Raw SSR HTML carries no result count (site uses a Coveo-driven grid with no server-rendered count text, matching the prior pass's finding that this site's PLPs are JS/Coveo-rendered); the Sitecore ProductDataApi referenced by the page (data-sitecore-product-data-url) requires product codes and returns an empty array for a bare category browse, so it could not be used for counting. Used Playwright (tier 2) to render https://www.iittala.com/en-gb/gifts/bestsellers: breadcrumb Home > GIFTS > Bestsellers, on-page H1 'BESTSELLERS', body copy 'Discover Iittala's most beloved items...these all-time favourites are sure to delight', a real product grid with Filter/Sorting controls, and the filter-bar summary text '43 results' appearing twice (once as a plain count, once as '43 products' in surrounding text) - both parses of the same summary line agree, so this is treated as the site's own exact count, not an estimate. This is a single undifferentiated Bestsellers listing; no genuine sub-categories were found (no Furniture/Tableware/etc. Bestsellers splits in nav or sitemap).
